name: High Protein Muesli Fruit+ Nuts & Seeds
ingredients_raw: Whole Grains 51% {Rolled Oats, Cornflakes (Corn Grits, Sugar, Salt, Malt Extract, Soy Lecithin, Natural Flavor), Millets 16% [Ragi Flakes (Ragi, Jaggery), Jowar Flakes (Jowar, Jaggery)], Rice Flakes), Protein Blend 28% (Texturized Soy Protein Flakes, Peanut Protein), Dehydrated Fruits 9% (Strawberry Powder, Raisins, Cranberry), Fructo-Oligosaccharide, Nuts and Seeds 4% (Almond, Pumpkin, Flax, Chia), Dates Syrup, Rice Bran Oil, Natural Flavours, Jaggery Syrup, Probiotics' (Bacillus Coagulans SNZ 1969, 15 billion CFU/g), Himalayan Pink Salt.
